content: Statusline performance pitfalls: git status/diff slow in large repos; multiple git subprocess calls per render add latency; recommended 2-5s file cache keyed by session_id; git --no-optional-locks avoids index lock churn; hard local-only rule (no git fetch, no network) with ~1s timeouts per command; slow scripts cause stale/blank statusline because Claude Code cancels in-flight runs.
